display_long_description:
Forge Your Legend. Fight for Glory.

Enter the brutal world of Ravenscar VR, a Viking-inspired virtual reality action adventure where survival depends on your strength, skill, and courage.

⚔️ Immersive VR Combat
Wield swords, axes, and shields in physical, hands-on combat. Strike, block, grab, and throw enemies as you battle your way through dangerous encounters.

🛡️ Four-Player Online Co-op
Fight alone or team up with up to three friends. Explore dungeons together, battle relentless enemies, and face powerful bosses.

⚔️ Level Up and Unlock Weapons
Earn experience by defeating enemies and completing dungeons. Level up to unlock new weapons and expand your arsenal. Your progression carries forward between adventures.

🔥 Optional PvP Arena
Challenge your friends in a dedicated arena and put your combat skills to the test.

Your Saga Begins Here
Gather your warriors, sharpen your blades, and prepare for battle.

EARLY ACCESS: Ravenscar VR is actively being developed, with additional content, improvements, and new features planned for future updates. - Online play may not be stable or optimized
